scripts.dev:storybook: pnpm --filter @meetpaul/tokens build && concurrently "pnpm --filter paul-storybook-react dev" "pnpm --filter paul-storybook-vue dev" "pnpm --filter paul-storybook-svelte dev" "pnpm --filter paul-storybook-angular dev"
scripts.build:storybook: pnpm --filter @meetpaul/tokens build && pnpm --filter paul-storybook-react build && pnpm --filter paul-storybook-vue build && pnpm --filter paul-storybook-svelte build && pnpm --filter paul-storybook-angular build
scripts.version:patch: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.version:minor: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm version minor --no-git-tag-version
scripts.version:major: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm version major --no-git-tag-version
